section.div: Favorites genres: Comedy, Action, Fantasy, Romance

div.div:
After a year in grade school without her childhood friends, first year student Akari Akaza is finally reunited with second years Yui Funami and Kyouko Toshinou at their all-girls' middle school. During the duo's first year, Yui and Kyouko formed the "Amusement Club" which occupies the now nonexistent Tea Club's room. Shortly after Akari joins, one of her fellow classmates, Chinatsu Yoshikawa, pays the trio a visit under the impression that they are the Tea Club; it is only once the three girls explain that the Tea Club has been disbanded that they can convince Chinatsu to join the Amusement Club—a group with no purpose other than to provide entertainment for its members.
(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Orphaned Sarasa just graduated from the Royal Alchemist Academy, and that means her longed-for life of elegance and riches is close at hand! As a graduation gift, her teacher gifts her a house to set up shop — but Sarasa’s dilapidated new digs are beyond far-flung. What’s a novice alchemist to do when they're stuck in the middle of nowhere with a business to run and supplies to gather from a very dangerous natural world? Whether it’s facing down frightening fantasy creatures or finding creative ways to attract customers, Sarasa has her work cut out for her as she achieves her dream of becoming the greatest alchemist around!
(Source: HIDIVE)
Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season Part 2

The war for Paradis zeroes in on Shiganshina just as Jaegerists have seized control. After taking a huge blow from a surprise attack led by Eren, Marley swiftly acts to return the favor. With Zeke’s true plan revealed and a military forced under new rule, this battle might be fought on two fronts. Does Eren intend on fulfilling his half-brother’s wishes or does he have a plan of his own?
(Source: Funimation)
Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 2nd Season

Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School seems like a paradise, but in reality, it is an extreme meritocracy. In the class of underachievers, Kiyotaka has begun working with Suzune, who seeks to ascend higher. After a survival test on an uninhabited island, they get to enjoy a luxury liner, but a new class-scrambling test will begin.
(Source: Anime News Network)
Drama, Romance, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life

A boy named Kyu meets a robot girl named Ichiko. Two gears that were never meant to mesh begin, at last, to turn. During summer vacation, Ichiko, a robot girl almost indistinguishable from a human, comes to live with Kyu Usami, who lives alone with his mother. As Ichiko sets out to learn what it means to have a “heart,” Kyu finds himself increasingly drawn to her. Meanwhile, his childhood friend Ai harbors feelings for Kyu of her own. Emotions slowly grow, intertwine, and begin to tangle together… Boy meets robot girl. The curtain rises! (Source: MANGA MILLION)

A little girl picks up a puppy abandoned in a cardboard box and takes it home. As the years pass, the father of the family forms a strong bond with the dog as his wife and daughter drift away from him. Faced with a divorce, he puts a few cardboard boxes and the dog in his car and drives south to see the sea.
